summary: Practise commercial contract drafting, document formatting and structured review. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Legal document drafting helps legal assistants, contract administrators and commercial professionals turn business instructions into clear, review-ready agreements and related documents. They practise structuring clauses and headings, using defined terms consistently, checking cross-references and obligations, and preparing tracked revisions and issue logs. The course also covers reviewing delivery terms and change controls, and maintaining digital version and approval records for legal and business review.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, review or administer commercial documents and need a consistent drafting process. It is designed for foundation-level learners who work with business terms, contract changes or legal document workflows.
modules: Legal Document Format and Plain Language
ICC Arbitration Rules and Dispute Clauses
Contract Review and CISG Risk Controls
prerequisites: Prior knowledge: familiarity with routine business documents or commercial transactions is helpful. The course assumes no prior contract-drafting experience. Coding is not required.
